description: Election Commission - Mr. H. J. R. Abeyrathne of the Ja-ela Urban Council has Vacated has Office of Member of that Ja-ela U/C
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Ja-Ela Urban Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a direct matter related to the composition of a local authority, falling under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content deals with an electoral process outcome (vacating an elected office) and is issued by a Returning Officer, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
